crossRefs.note: “ ‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her…
“ ‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin…
The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good…
one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
(but how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule one’s own house take care of God’s assembly?)
Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly…
When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
translations.bsb: And they shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.
translations.kjv: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest
translations.asv: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away; but they shall take virgins of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that is the widow of a priest.
